name: client_request_id
description: Mandatory x-client-request-id propagated across 1:N upstream gateway failover attempts.

name: trace_id
description: W3C 32-hex trace identifier normalized from gateway traceparent or Cloud Logging trace.

name: span_id
description: Caller or gateway span identifier correlating (client_request_id, span_id) to model_calls.

name: response_id
description: Provider gen_ai.response.id when returned (NULL on HTTP 429 or upstream transport failure).

name: attempt_index
description: 1..N upstream attempt sequence number within (client_request_id, span_id) across gateway failover.

name: request_time
description: UTC timestamp when the gateway dispatched the upstream attempt.

name: trace_owner_app_id
description: Caller/desk application ID resolved via SCD-2 app_registry with precedence over the gateway service name.

name: billing_project_id
description: Upstream cloud billing project or account identifier charged for this attempt.

name: provider
description: Upstream model provider identifier (google, anthropic, openai, self_hosted).

name: request_model
description: Model identifier requested by the gateway on this attempt.

name: response_model
description: Serving model identifier returned by the upstream endpoint (never defaulted from request_model).

name: upstream_endpoint_location
description: Upstream serving region or multi-region endpoint location.

name: state_mode
description: Gateway/session state mode (stateless_chat, stateful_cmek_platform, stateful_cmek_gateway, zdr_stateless).

name: pool_id
description: Commercial order or capacity pool identifier targeted by this attempt.

name: runtime_pool_id
description: Merged FCFS runtime capacity bucket resolved from gateway log or SCD-2 capacity_pools.

name: serving_tier
description: Serving capacity tier (PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT, PRIORITY, STANDARD, FLEX).

name: tier_source
description: Serving-tier provenance: server, inferred (dedicated no-spillover route), or inferred_ambiguous (3P shared spillover without server TrafficType).

name: http_status_code
description: Upstream HTTP status code (e.g., 200, 429, 503).

name: input_tokens
description: Server-billed total prompt tokens on this attempt.

name: output_tokens
description: Server-billed completion tokens on this attempt.

name: cache_read_tokens
description: Server-billed cached prefix read tokens.

name: cache_write_5m_tokens
description: Server-billed 5-minute ephemeral cache-write tokens from gateway records.

name: cache_write_1h_tokens
description: Server-billed 1-hour ephemeral cache-write tokens from gateway records.

name: reasoning_tokens
description: Server-billed reasoning/thinking output tokens.

name: weighted_burndown_units
description: Gateway-emitted weighted burndown units when stamped on the log row (NULL when absent; never priced in Silver).

name: ttft_ms
description: Streaming time-to-first-token in milliseconds observed at the gateway.

name: latency_ms
description: Upstream attempt round-trip latency in milliseconds.

name: thought_signature_present
description: TRUE when multi-turn reasoning signature state was preserved on this attempt.

name: traffic_type
description: Gateway-stamped FinOps traffic attribution bucket.

name: traffic_type_attested
description: TRUE when traffic_type was stamped by the platform gateway, NULL when traffic_type is absent.

name: trigger_principal
description: Write-IAM-attested OBO trigger service or workload principal.

name: agent_principal
description: Write-IAM-attested OBO caller agent principal.

name: auth_method
description: Write-IAM-attested OBO authentication method.

name: issuer
description: Write-IAM-attested OBO token issuer URI.

name: aud
description: Write-IAM-attested OBO token audience.

name: delegation_chain_hash
description: Open-safe attested OBO delegation chain digest.

name: labels
description: Open-safe registered slice-only attributes JSON object.
